# proxmox_node_network_interface (Resource)

Manages one Linux interface of a Proxmox VE node through `/nodes/{node}/network`. Writes only stage the change in `/etc/network/interfaces.new`; nothing takes effect until `proxmox_node_network_apply` for the node runs. OVS and SDN-owned interfaces are not supported. Destroy only removes the staged configuration, so a later apply is required to deactivate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Interfaces are only staged in /etc/network/interfaces.new. Nothing is
# activated until proxmox_node_network_apply for the node runs.
# Provider credentials need Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}.

# A VLAN-aware bridge for guests, with one uplink port.
resource "proxmox_node_network_interface" "vmbr1" {
  node              = "node1"
  iface             = "vmbr1"
  type              = "bridge"
  address           = "10.0.1.2"
  netmask           = "255.255.255.0"
  bridge_ports      = ["eth1"]
  bridge_vlan_aware = true
  bridge_vids       = "2 4 100-200"
  comments          = "Guest bridge managed by Terraform"
  autostart         = true
}

# A VLAN on top of the uplink, with jumbo frames.
resource "proxmox_node_network_interface" "vlan100" {
  node            = "node1"
  iface           = "eth1.100"
  type            = "vlan"
  vlan_id         = 100
  vlan_raw_device = "eth1"
  mtu             = 9000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `iface` (String) Interface name such as `vmbr1`, `bond1`, `bond0.100`, or `eth1`. Must not already exist; changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Cluster node that owns the interface. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) Interface type: `bridge`, `bond`, `vlan`, or `eth`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Static IPv4 address. Must be paired with `netmask`.
- `address6` (String) Static IPv6 address. Must be paired with `netmask6`.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Bring the interface up on boot.
- `bond_mode` (String) Bonding mode such as `active-backup` or `802.3ad`.
- `bond_primary` (String) Primary interface for an `active-backup` bond.
- `bond_xmit_hash_policy` (String) Transmit hash policy for `balance-xor` and `802.3ad` bonds.
- `bridge_ports` (Set of String) Bridge member interfaces. Proxmox stores them space separated in sorted order.
- `bridge_vids` (String) Allowed VLANs such as `2 4 100-200`, only used when the bridge is VLAN aware.
- `bridge_vlan_aware` (Boolean) Enable VLAN filtering on the bridge.
- `comments` (String) IPv4 comment stored as `comments`.
- `comments6` (String) IPv6 comment stored as `comments6`.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 default gateway. Only one interface per node may define it.
- `gateway6` (String) IPv6 default gateway. Only one interface per node may define it.
- `mtu` (Number) Interface MTU between 1280 and 65520.
- `netmask` (String) IPv4 netmask. Must be paired with `address`.
- `netmask6` (Number) IPv6 prefix length between 0 and 128. Must be paired with `address6`.
- `slaves` (Set of String) Bond member interfaces.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN tag between 1 and 4094.
- `vlan_raw_device` (String) Raw interface the VLAN sits on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Interface identifier in `<node>/<iface>` form.
